name: AdScale
summary: Smoke-grey performance ad agency site with tight grotesk headlines finished by an italic serif word, a glowing phone of sale notifications and one violet accent.

fonts.pairing: Inter Display 400 with very tight negative tracking for headings; the last word of most headings swaps to Source Serif 4 italic

signature: headline ends on an italic serif word in the same size (sans then serif switch)
phone mock with stacked store-order notifications sliding in over a violet glow
dark rounded process panel with four tilted note cards wired to a central glowing icon
small pill chips with a sparkle icon above every section title
imagery: phone UI and platform dashboards with growth charts in soft pastel gradients; studio portraits and lifestyle product photos for team and case studies
layout_grid: 1080px content (1200 frame, 60px sides), 100px section padding, centred section headers, 16 to 32px card radius, white cards on a smoke background, a single dark rounded band
